title: What does an AI agent really cost? (cost per outcome)

scenes.text: Your AI agent costs just over one cent per attempt. Are you sure that's cheap?
Let's do the math with the support example from the Labs calculator: ten thousand cases a month. Model and tools come to about €133.
But there are 12% retries. And it gets 86% right: that leaves 1,400 failures someone has to redo.
And a person reviews one in four cases. The result: the model is just 1% of the cost. 99% is human work.
It still pays off: about €10,200 a month, versus almost €51,000 for the manual process.
So the lesson: don't compare price per token. Compare the cost per correct outcome.
Because cost per outcome will decide which agents survive.
Save it, and share it with whoever approves your AI budget.
